bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W159: Integrated Build Harness State Machine And Result Import Handoff. Use the W158 dry-run poll-cycle contract to promote the harness-only Build states into a single drawer state machine: blocked, no-submit, queued, polling, completed-awaiting-W151-import, imported, and error-recoverable. Keep real invocation disabled by default, do not enable real writes, do not create records from the drawer, do not invoke SuiteScript from the drawer outside the approved server adapter path, and do not request visual testing. Preserve W151 completed-result import guard, consultant confirmation, state authority and handoff parity, internal runner ownership, rollback by disabling server flags, and no active Open links without real URLs. Output Build state-machine contract, guarded harness, trace samples, W159 report, visual testing decision blocked, and best next Codex prompt.
